SELECT DS.INTEGRATION_ID, DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, LED.ROW_WID AS LEDGER_WID, DS.ALLOCATED_FLAG, DS.CODE_TYPE, DS.DETAIL_ID, DS.FLEX_VALUE_ID, DS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID, DS.TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID, PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_WID, DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_ON_DT, UDC.ROW_WID AS PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_WID, DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT, UAC.ROW_WID AS PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_WID, DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_ON_DT, UHR.ROW_WID AS PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_WID, DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_ON_DT, UDR.ROW_WID AS PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_WID, DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_ON_DT, UAR.ROW_WID AS PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_WID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID, CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID FROM WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS DS LEFT JOIN W_LEDGER_D LED ON DS.LEDGER_ID = LED.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = LED.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND LED.DELETE_FLG = 'N' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UHC ON DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID = UHC.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UHC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UHC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UHR ON DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID = UHR.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UHR.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UHR.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UDC ON DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID = UDC.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UDC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UDC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UDR ON DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID = UDR.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UDR.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UDR.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UAC ON DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID = UAC.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UAC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UAC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN W_USER_D UAR ON DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID = UAR.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = UAR.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND UAR.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'

SCOPE: covers the full SQ_WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS 7-way LEFT JOIN SQL override (W_LEDGER_D for LEDGER_WID with DELETE_FLG='N', and 6x W_USER_D aliases keyed on INTEGRATION_ID+DATASOURCE_NUM_ID+CURRENT_FLG='Y' for the HDR/DTL/ALLOC CREATED_BY_WID/CHANGED_BY_WID pairs), plus all 6 CMS_PRC_*_BY_ID IIF(LEDGER_WID=2, <id>, NULL) branches from EXPTRANS, reproduced independently via CASE WHEN and differently-aliased joins. Composite key is INTEGRATION_ID + DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, matching LKP_WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_D's self-lookup condition.

OUT OF SCOPE (flagged, not silently dropped): ROW_WID (sequence/lookup-generated surrogate), W_UPDATE_DT (SESSSTARTTIME), ETL_PROC_WID (mapplet MPLT_GET_ETL_PROC_WID). The router's INSERT/UPDATE branching is a run-to-run CDC concern, not verifiable via a single-snapshot DataCompare -- recommend running this test after a full/initial load so every row is on the INSERT path.

CAVEAT: CMS_PRC_*_BY_ID population depends on LEDGER_WID literally equal to 2 (hardcoded, environment-specific) -- confirm test data includes at least one row mapping to LEDGER_WID=2, else that branch is untested (a vacuous pass).

NOT DRAFTED: HHS_SIL_DATA_ACT_CONTROL_DUMMY (workflow's 2nd mapping) is a same-table straight passthrough with no testable business logic beyond an unreferenced $$DATA_ACT_REPORTING_PERIOD mapping variable -- an expected query for it would just be a copy of its own query, which proves nothing.

GENUINE POTENTIAL MAPPING DEFECT FLAGGED (not a test bug): PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC, CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL, and the six raw *_BY_ID columns do NOT literally appear in the SQ_WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS SQL override's SELECT list (only in JOIN ON predicates, for the *_BY_ID columns) even though field_lineage traces them as passthrough through this same SQ. This test's expected query includes them as real WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS staging columns (the intended/should-be behavior) -- if the deployed override truly omits them, actual values may come back NULL/misaligned, and this DataCompare should correctly surface that as a mismatch. Investigate if this test fails specifically on these columns.
